items.computation: The period runs from receipt (Zugang). The receipt date is not stated, and no statutory delivery fiction applies to a private company's letter. The letter is dated 19.04.2027, so the earliest possible receipt is 19.04.2027. Under §§ 187 Abs. 1 and 188 Abs. 2 BGB, three months from 19.04.2027 end on 19.07.2027, which is a Monday and not a holiday. If the letter arrived later, the deadline moves later, for example 22.04.2027 gives 22.07.2027. I used the earliest plausible date to be safe. The cancellation is effective at the earliest on 01.06.2027.
